records.facts_used: Vaane goes back to a name in the Livonian Chronicle of Henry: Vane was a Livonian, and the chronicle writes the related name as Manivalde. records.evidence_locations: Rajandi PDF140–141/printed142–143, Peter ~ Petrus entry (text layer); Mägiste 1929 PDF48 Peet ~ Peedu with medieval Peth, Pieth; Mägiste 1936 PDF42.
records.facts_used: Peet is one of the Estonian forms of Peter, from the Greek petros, ‘rock’. Its medieval popularity rested on the veneration of the apostle Peter.
